summary: A Best Current Practice document that gives implementation recommendations for SMTP mail transfer agents so they can better reduce the impact of spam, for example by tightening how mail is relayed. It asks for discussion and suggestions for improvement.

eli5.summary: Junk mail floods the post office. This document tells the mail-sorting machines how to be stricter about who they carry mail for, so spammers can't use them for free.

questions: how to reduce spam in smtp servers
anti spam recommendations for mail servers
